svg.title: A name is a sticky note. Assignment moves the note.
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “A name is a sticky note. Assignment moves the note.” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Two sticky notes labelled a and b both point at one list object with refcount 2 and cells 1, 2, 3 and a dashed 4 appended through a. Beside it, the picture most people hold — two separate list objects — is crossed out in red, and the contrasting case a = a + [4] is drawn as a genuinely new object. Below, the CPython object header is drawn field by field with measured sizes, and six bars compare per-record memory for a million records from 268 bytes in a dict down to 28 bytes columnar.
svg.text: A name is a sticky note. Assignment moves the note.
draw it from memory, then compare
